cross_case_boundary: Employment, police, bail, healthcare, detention, and custody remain separate causal and legal domains.
Formal failure findings cannot be promoted into individual culpability or legal liability.
A missing public consequence record is missing evidence, not proof of impunity.
Training, policy, and review activity cannot be promoted into worker repair or accountable consequence.
